Swapping uncomfortable historical facts for sanitizing narratives leaves new generations vulnerable to ignorance.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing pedagogical sensitivity (WHO/HOW) with historical erasure (WHAT/CAUSE).

Social Physics Analysis:
Administrators run a Smart Selfish Maneuver by using noble pretexts of inclusion to mask institutional risk-aversion, shifting blame onto critics while avoiding ideological friction.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Deception. Pretexts of safety mask the quiet erasure of uncomfortable historical facts.

The Unavoidable Truth: Historical omissions on 9/11 cultivate profound civic ignorance.

The Unavoidable Lie: Sanitizing curricula prevents all forms of student trauma.
